shortDescription: Chile, the world's largest copper producer, exported $4.63 billion worth of the metal in June, down 3.2% from the same month a year earlier, the central bank said on Monday.Despite the decline in the value of copper exports, Chile posted a trade surplus of $1.69 billion that month, it added.

children: Chile, the world's largest copper producer, exported $4.63 billion worth of the metal in June, down 3.2% from the same month a year earlier, the central bank said on Monday.
Despite the decline in the value of copper exports, Chile posted a trade surplus of $1.69 billion that month, it added.
